seed_expert_discoveries.technical_takeaway: Strong at agentic coding, only slightly worse than K3 but 2x cheaper; top model in its price range for practical agent workflows.
Public beta adds opinionated evals (Harbor), agent/user-level memory, OAuth for tools, Slack/GitHub integrations, and sandbox support to let developers focus on agent logic instead of infra.
Bots now handle support chats, clear captchas, and escalate issues with full receipts; questions whether captchas remain viable against capable agents.
New GitHub repo provides a harness for computer-use agent development and testing.

global_discoveries.technical_takeaway: Free public-preview guide shows how a managed memory layer (consolidation, scoping, shared stores) turns stateless agents into persistent, contradiction-aware systems that share context across agents without repetition.
